item.title: Morocco is testing a 'sponge' pavement that stays 16°F cooler by itself, aims at replacing black asphalt
item.description: Morocco is pioneering a novel sponge pavement designed to enhance water management and mitigate heat effects. This initiative aims to bolster urban climate resilience and elevate the comfort of residents, with pilot projects underway in Marrakech and Agadir as part of a larger sustainable city initiative.
